paragraph_details.text: Explore your creativity and shape the future of the built environment with Architecture and Design at UWA. Our courses blend innovation, sustainability, and technical expertise, preparing you for a dynamic career in architecture, landscape architecture, and urban design.

Studying Architecture and Design at UWA equips you with the skills to transform spaces and communities. Through a combination of design studios, technical courses, and collaborative projects, you will develop a deep understanding of architecture, urbanism, and environmental design.

Our strong industry connections provide valuable networking opportunities, internships, and exposure to real-world challenges. Whether you aspire to design sustainable cities, heritage restorations, or cutting-edge structures, UWA will prepare you for success.

paragraph_details.text: You'll be taught by dedicated academic and professional teaching staff who have won national and international awards in teaching and design. With extensive global experience, they are actively shaping the future of design - helping you gain a global perspective into architecture and design.
You'll work on projects from housing and museums to space stations, and gain hands-on experience with real sites through industry and community engagement opportunities.
You'll have access to our state-of-the-art facilities and equipment, such as plastic-extrusion 3D printers, laser cutters, printmaking studios and 24/7 computer labs.

You'll be in the same building as other creative disciplines such as architecture, landscape architecture, fine arts, urban design and history of art, placing you in a unique, collaborative and creative hub.
